note: One list of every strategy. Score out of 100, always: evidence up to 30; four checks at 10 each (a check that does not apply earns nothing); each full cycle of fix and re-review 10, up to 20; and 10 for a result on our own page. Parked and rejected strategies get no score. No strategy has had a full fix-and-re-review cycle yet. The score is counted from what is recorded here, nothing else.
